rows.ja: 顧客(相手の年次報告に記載)

relations.text: コヒューは、Jabilの工場に半導体ATE(試験装置)の専用製造拠点を置いている
relations.text_en: Cohu has dedicated semiconductor ATE manufacturing operations at a Jabil facility

source.label: Cohu 10-K
source.quote: Cohu’s supply chain is further strengthened by long-standing relationships with strategic partners, including dedicated semiconductor ATE manufacturing operations at a facility of Jabil, Inc.

relations.text: コヒューは半導体試験システムの大半の製造をマレーシアのJabil工場に依存している
relations.text_en: Cohu depends on Jabil to manufacture most of its semiconductor test systems at a facility in Malaysia

source.label: Cohu 10-K
source.quote: For example, we depend upon Jabil to manufacture most of our semiconductor test systems from its facility located in Malaysia.

companies.name: アリスタネットワークス

relations.text: アリスタは主な製造パートナーとしてJabil、Sanmina、Foxconn Hon Haiを挙げている
relations.text_en: Arista names Jabil, Sanmina and Foxconn Hon Hai as its primary manufacturing partners

source.label: Arista Networks 10-K
source.quote: Our primary manufacturing partners are Jabil Inc., Sanmina Corporation and Foxconn Hon Hai.

relations.text: 2024年12月、Amazon.com NV Investment Holdings LLCに普通株最大1,158,539株を取得できるワラントを発行した
relations.text_en: In December 2024, issued a warrant to Amazon.com NV Investment Holdings LLC to acquire up to 1,158,539 of its ordinary shares

source.label: Jabil 10-K
source.quote: In December 2024, we issued a warrant to Amazon.com NV Investment Holdings LLC to acquire up to 1,158,539 of our ordinary shares as reported in a Current Report on Form 8-K filed on January 3, 2025.

relations.text: このワラントの初期行使価格は1株137.7671ドルで、直前30取引日のVWAPである
relations.text_en: The warrant has an initial exercise price of $137.7671 per share, the preceding 30 trading day VWAP

source.label: Jabil 10-K
source.quote: On December 27, 2024, we issued a warrant (the “Warrant”) to Amazon.com NV Investment Holdings LLC (“Warrantholder”) to acquire up to 1,158,539 of our ordinary shares (“Warrant Shares”) at an initial exercise price of $137.7671 per share, which is the preceding 30 trading day VWAP.

relations.text: Jabilが、Intelのシリコンフォトニクス方式のプラガブル光トランシーバー製品の製造・販売を引き継ぐと発表した
relations.text_en: Jabil announced it will take over the manufacture and sale of Intel's current Silicon Photonics-based pluggable optical transceiver product lines

source.label: Jabil の発表
source.quote: Jabil Inc. (NYSE: JBL), a global leader in design, manufacturing, and supply chain solutions, today announced it will take over the manufacture and sale of Intel’s current Silicon Photonics
source.note: 2023年の発表で、やや古い情報です。

companies.name: ユナイテッド・マイクロエレクトロニクス

relations.text: HyperLight、UMC、Jabilが、TFLNフォトニクスをデータセンター規模で展開する協業を発表した
relations.text_en: HyperLight, UMC and Jabil announced a collaboration to deploy TFLN photonics at data-center scale

source.label: HyperLight, UMC and Jabil の発表
source.label_en: HyperLight, UMC and Jabil press release (Business Wire)
source.quote: The collaboration brings together HyperLight’s TFLN photonic technology, UMC and Wavetek’s qualified foundry manufacturing, and Jabil’s expertise in high-volume manufacturing and assembly to support deployment of next-generation optical modules at data-center scale.

companies.name: アダニ・エンタープライジズ

relations.text: Adani EnterprisesとJabilが、インドでAI・データセンター機器を製造する50対50の合弁事業に向けた覚書を結んだ
relations.text_en: Adani Enterprises and Jabil signed a non-binding MoU for a proposed 50:50 joint venture to manufacture AI and data centre equipment in India

source.label: Adani Group の発表
source.quote: Adani Enterprises Limited (AEL), the flagship company of the Adani Group, and Jabil Inc. (NYSE: JBL), a global engineering, supply chain and manufacturing company, have signed a non-binding Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) setting out the framework for a proposed 50:50 joint venture to manufacture and assemble artificial intelligence (AI) and data centre equipment in India.
source.note: 拘束力のない覚書の段階です。

relations.text: JabilとViTroxが提携し、ViTroxのデジタル工場ソリューションV-ONEをJabilの製造に導入した
relations.text_en: Jabil and ViTrox partnered to integrate ViTrox's V-ONE digital factory solution into Jabil's manufacturing

source.label: ViTrox の発表
source.quote: This partnership focuses on navigating the complexities of Industry 4.0, combining Jabil’s manufacturing expertise with ViTrox’s smart technology to drive operational agility and data-driven decision-making.

companies.name: ベンチマーク・エレクトロニクス

relations.text: ベンチマーク・エレクトロニクスの年次報告が、ジェイビルを競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Names Jabil as a competitor in its annual report

source.label: Benchmark Electronics 10-K
source.quote: Our competitors include Celestica Inc., Flex Ltd., Jabil Inc., Kimball Electronics Inc., Plexus Corp, and Sanmina Corporation.

companies.name: ウルトラ・クリーン・ホールディングス
companies.sub: 半導体装置サブシステム

relations.text: ウルトラ・クリーン・ホールディングスの年次報告が、ジェイビルを競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Names Jabil as a competitor in its annual report

source.label: Ultra Clean Holdings 10-K
source.quote: Our principal competitors for gas delivery systems are Ichor Systems, Inc. and Fujikin Incorporated; our principal competitors for other critical subsystems are Foxsemicon Integrated Technology Inc., Jabil, Inc., VDL ETG, Celestica Inc. and Benchmark Electronics, Inc.
source.note: 半導体装置のサブシステム分野での競合としての記載です。
source.note_en: Listed as a competitor for critical subsystems.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
